_meta.title: A+B cruising candidate audit, positions 56–60
_meta.source_method: Source comment evidence plus direct 2026 municipal/operator/current-road reports where available. Eight-source archive coverage carried forward, not represented as exhaustive authenticated browsing.
_meta.editorial_caution: Owner authorizes research only. Do not conflate reported visit, meeting intention, online check-in and verified consensual activity.

records.name: Volkspark Prenzlauer Berg - Judith-Auer-Straße
records.geography: Original gay-szene entry specifies park access near Judith-Auer-Straße tram stop and wooded slope. Saved 52.53579,13.46303 is general park reference rather than current individual trail location; current first-person comments identify tree-covered area without a unique GPS map.

recent_activity.detail: Poster says they visited recently in the afternoon and had success; self-reported, not independently verified.
Poster reports visiting briefly and intending return; no sexual activity claimed.

records.access: Public municipal park with footpaths, residents and mixed users; no evidence of authorised sex area or guaranteed privacy.
records.duplicates: Other wooded parks are distinct locations; not automatically duplicate of Volkspark Friedrichshain despite source discussion comparing them.
needed_corrections: Existing description accurately distinguishes positive July experience and June presence; preserve attribution.
Avoid presenting exact wooded path or time as a guaranteed meeting location.
No claim 2026 interest represents high consistent attendance.

records.name: Parkplatz A1 Krumhörens Kuhlen
records.geography: Named motorway parking area Krummhörens Kuhlen on A1 in direction Hamburg, in Weyhe/Stuhr south of Bremen, not downtown Bremen. Saved 53.02295,8.82746 plausibly named rest area but wooded lakeside paths not independently reverified.

recent_activity.detail: Poster says they visited frequently in April and found very little activity, an actual negative attendance report.

records.access: Motorway parking entered only via correct direction and official bays. Potential wetlands, fences, and past safety reports require ordinary caution.
records.duplicates: Historical A1 stop distinct from other motorway rest areas; no same-place merge established.
needed_corrections: Do not use 2023 older positive account to imply 2026 continuing success.
Preserve source's repeated April 2026 negative firsthand activity evidence.
Do not treat historical 2021 robbery allegation as verified present threat.

records.name: Uni-See
records.geography: Stadtwaldsee/Uni-See public lake near Bremen University, with marked naturist area. Saved 53.1119,8.82325 is general lake, not one definitive former cruising path. Uni-Wildnis nature reserve adjacent, old informal woodland boundaries altered.

recent_activity.detail: A user reports onsite experience and says some encounters may remain possible; no independent verification.

records.access: Bremen official/current local Oct 21 2026 reports northern shore remediation scheduled to begin in November 2026. Unsafe unstable sand and fence installation: city environment agency warns of life-threatening quicksand-like newly deposited sand in winter, and unstable embankment. Works are localized to north shore, not grounds for claiming all Uni-See closed. Public FKK bathing rules and conservation restriction still apply.
records.duplicates: Lake Uni-See and nature reserve Uni-Wildnis share vicinity but are not interchangeable same meeting zone; don't merge with unrelated Bremen parks.
needed_corrections: Add high-priority explicit warning about 2026 north-shore works, temporary fences and dangerous unconsolidated sand in future owner-approved listing data.
Do not presume construction means full lake closed or current FKK shore unavailable.
Keep newer 2026 in-person accounts separate from evidence of specific sexual encounter.

records.name: Cranachwald
records.geography: Cranachwäldchen is wooded Rhine-side area at Am Molenkopf, Köln-Niehl. Saved 50.9745,6.9921 is general woodland, not verified unique secluded sub-area. Original two-site alignment identifies Gays-Cruising and gay-szene as named references.

recent_activity.detail: Source message describes visits/meetup interest; no documented dated completed sexual encounter.
Anonymous post warns about fallen/damaged trees; no professional recent arborist survey verified.

records.access: Rhine riverside and woodland; unsafe branches after storms claimed by visitors, plus high wind and riverbank safety. No verified sex venue, private woodland access or exact FKK legal boundary.
records.duplicates: Do not confuse Cranachwäldchen with other Cologne Rhine-side cruising woods.
needed_corrections: Retain July2026 user-reported branches risk with attribution, no blanket claim entire woodland objectively unsafe.
Keep quoted Dec2025 contacts distinct from witnessed activity.
Avoid unsupported age, busy time or capacity assertions.

records.name: Parking lot Lustheide
records.geography: Named Lustheide A4 parking stop, saved 50.946163,7.113735 exactly matches roadworks rest-area entry. Opposite-direction Refrath is separate stop; old sources use names inconsistently. Owner excluded Refrath but candidate Lustheide remains, subject to owner authorization for any future publication.

recent_activity.detail: Visitor says Lustheide direction Cologne reopened, not proof of cruising there.

records.access: Autobahn-Baustellen source (Aug 22 2026) documents Lustheide A4 as existing rest area, 39 car spaces and 3 officially marked HGV spaces; live telemetry is approximate. Operator Autobahn GmbH describes periodic highway works near Lustheide. Current road information contains repairs around adjacent Bergisch Gladbach-Frankenforst and Lustheide, including Nov 9–11 overnight restrictions; these are potential route constraints, NOT a confirmed closed parking area for every hour.
records.duplicates: Lustheide vs Refrath are opposite carriageway names, not merged; keep source alias ambiguity separately documented.
needed_corrections: Existing April reopening is a dated forum claim; source now corroborates mapped operating rest-area infrastructure, but no confirmed current cruising.
Include current A4 access/roadworks caveat in future approved listing revision.
No false implied access from opposite highway carriageway.

notable: Uni-See Bremen Oct 2026 official north shore winter works/unstable sand hazard
Lustheide A4 rest stop independently confirmed GPS/capacity, but road works Nov2026
Volkspark Prenzlauer Berg Jul11 first-person meeting claim contrasts with other nearby park question-only records
